content:
Jamie: Quick sync — Hypatia legal sent over their security questionnaire and they want a PoC for SSO+SCIM next week. asking to confirm scope and blockers.
Olivia: Thanks — what's the exact ask? full SCIM provisioning, just SSO, or RBAC import?
Jamie: They want SAML SSO (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated), SCIM provisioning of users + groups, and role mapping for Admin/Agent/Viewer. Also domain ownership proof for 3 domains.
Kevin: FYI pricing — for a PoC that includes SCIM sync tests + 1-week dedicated support, we usually quote a trial seat + a short term Dedicated pool (small) if token volumes are heavy. I'll post numbers once we know expected users/sync rate.
Rahul: Technical: SCIM rate/throughput matters. If they provision 5k users in a bulk import we need backoff strategy. Do we have a sample delta sync plan?
Olivia: Attachments: the security questionnaire is long, but main blockers are: admin audit logs retention, SAML cert rotation policy, SCIM delta vs full sync, and cross-tenant RBAC constraints.
Morgan: On compliance side: Hypatia requires KMS-backed key storage for SAML signing keys and HSM for private certs. We support KMS integrations (AWS/GCP) — need to confirm if on-prem HSM is mandatory.
Jamie: @Morgan good point — they marked HSM as preferred but 'can accept cloud KMS' if contract adds SOC/Security annex. Can you confirm what language we need?
Morgan: I can draft an annex. Also asking about retention windows — they want 1 year of audit logs for user provisioning events. Our current hosted retention is 90d by default; enterprise addon supports 365d.
Kevin: Pricing note: 365d audit retention is an add-on. For PoC we can enable 90d and show evidence; if they require 365d for the PoC we need to scope add-on cost.
Rahul: SCIM implementation detail: we support SCIM 2.0 bulk endpoints but most customers use pagination + delta tokens. For their import plan, recommend a two-phase approach: 1) initial bulk import off-peak via CSV->SCIM bulk, 2) enable delta sync (ETag/Last-Modified) for ongoing.
Olivia: I'll prepare a short runbook. Quick example SCIM mapping they asked for (role import snippet):
```
# SCIM POST /Users payload example
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "j.doe@hypatia.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"},
  "emails": [{"value":"j.doe@hypatia.com","primary":true}],
  "urn:enterprise:roles": ["Agent"]
}
# mapping -> Redwood roles: Agent -> 'hypatia_agent', Admin -> 'hypatia_admin'
```
Jamie: Good. Hypatia also asked about RBAC scoping per domain subtenant: they have multiple business units and want domain-locking (users for biz1.example.com cannot access biz2.example.com datasets). Is that supported?
Rahul: We have tenant-scoped RBAC. For Hosted we can model each business unit as a tenant and configure domain claims to map users to the right tenant. For Dedicated/Private we can deploy VPC-level isolation if they need network separation.
Morgan: Also confirm SAML NameID formats — they want persistent NameID + signed assertions + encrypted assertions. We support signed assertions; encryption requires extra config on the IdP side.
Kevin: Commercial ask: Hypatia needs a 30-day trial PoC with 3k monthly active tokens and 2k provisioning ops. If we ship this as Hosted PoC, include 24/7 oncall for the week of go-live as a one-time fee. Otherwise Dedicated trial has different pricing.
Jamie: Action items: 1) Olivia prepare SCIM runbook and test plan by EOD tomorrow. 2) Morgan draft security annex & retention statement. 3) Rahul outline SCIM bulk/delta strategy + rate limits. 4) Kevin provide PoC pricing and an optional Dedicated quote.
Olivia: I'll create a test checklist: sample CSV for initial import, SCIM call examples, expected SCIM response codes, idempotency notes.
Rahul: Rate limits note I'll add to checklist: recommend target throughput <= 50 provisioning ops/sec for delta sync in PoC, and backoff using Retry-After header.
Morgan: Drafting annex now. One question: do we have precedent language for HSM substitution with Attestation that Hypatia might accept?
Kevin: We can offer KMS + SOC attestation for PoC. For full contract they can opt for HSM with additional cost.
Jamie: Hypatia scheduled a technical kickoff Wed 10am PT. Can everyone join? We need Olivia and Morgan there. Kevin can present commercials.
Olivia: I can do Wed 10am PT. Morgan and Rahul?
Rahul: Wed 10am PT works for me.
Morgan: I'm available.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled meeting created — Hypatia PoC Kickoff — Wed 10:00 PT — link: https://meet.redwood.com/hypatia-poc
Jamie: Great — I'll loop in legal after Morgan shares annex draft. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Kevin: I'll queue pricing doc and a short contract clause draft.
Jamie: End of thread — moving to the kickoff prep channel after meeting notes.
